title: Lock, pick-resistant
summary: A mechanical lock that requires two physical pick-resistant keys in tandem. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with locksmith’s tools can pick this lock with a successful DC…
markdown: A mechanical lock that requires two physical pick-resistant keys in tandem. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with locksmith’s tools can pick this lock with a successful DC 19 Dexterity check. Better locks are available at higher prices.
